standard: DR-0061 / P15 — every value on a trust surface traces to real state; no painted data
method: Independent read-only audit of each surface slice against its real data source (props/state/query/records); painted-live-state distinguished from legit authored content + gated seed data (SEED-DATA-AS-ASPIRATION).

areas.label: App root · Big Picture dashboard
areas.note: Big Picture KPI tiles are all useMemo-derived from real `data`; buffer figure carries a comment noting it replaced a former painted slider (DR-0061).

areas.label: Inbound & business metrics
areas.note: Every count/dollar/status traces to real props, hook state, or live RPC/query; several files carry explicit 'nothing painted' enforcement comments.

areas.label: Learn & progress
areas.note: No painted progress — every %/streak/done-count traces to real records. LOW: Practice.jsx:436 substitutes a hardcoded 50% conversion under an 'Estimates until Acuity sync' banner (non-progress revenue estimate seam).

areas.label: Church ops & media
areas.note: Every count/status/budget/schedule traces to a real subscription, state, or record; hardcoded material is authored content (Scripture, CapEx record, curated catalog) honestly framed as such.

areas.label: Dashboards & metrics
areas.note: Every trust number is prop/lib/real-record/real-localStorage derived or honestly framed. Watch (not painted): About.jsx '~5,900 checks' is an approximate marketing claim that could drift from the real test count.

areas.label: Ops & health
areas.note: Every health/status/count/timestamp traces to real props, live fetches, real RPC/queries, or the committed ledger, with honest 'not connected / never updated / not yet measured' fallbacks instead of painted green. DevOps.jsx is a business tab (authored projections/pricing), not a status surface.

areas.label: Build & project boards
areas.note: Every metric/%/count/status/date traces to real records, a build-time-derived stream, or a live store. The P15-originating hand-typed ROADMAP constant is explicitly retired; seed rows are flag-gated and labeled.

areas.label: Books & money
areas.note: Every balance/total/count/%/status traces to real ledger/account/record state or a live engine; missing figures are flagged, not zeroed. Static values are labeled business-rule thresholds, user-editable defaults, or authored hero copy (e.g. Debts intro '11 rental properties').

areas.label: Real estate · Rentals
areas.note: Every rent/count/%/total/status traces to real property/unit/lease records or a pure rollup; missing figures honestly flagged, not zeroed. The room-income 'collecting now' is a per-room-editable, labeled potential model (documented design, SEED-DATA-AS-ASPIRATION), not painted.

areas.label: Community surfaces
areas.note: Every count/status/%/date traces to real props, derived computations, live subscriptions, or API fetches; the only hardcoded values are enum lists, authored copy, a documented V2 directory skeleton, or flag-gated local-fallback seed.
